responsibility: Declares the parameter-lowering helpers that turn Rust function parameter patterns into backend parameter variables. It defines visitor-based support for ordinary parameters and a separate self-parameter helper, including the interfaces used by function compilation to create formal Bvariables and to handle destructuring patterns at function entry.
same_name_distinction: Declares the function-parameter and self-parameter lowering helpers, including the pattern visitor interface used by function compilation. Unlike the .cc peer, it does not create parameter Bvariables or destructuring bindings; it just exposes the API and visitor shape for that implementation.
